description: This file contains functions for processing Markdown content, extracting translatable segments, applying translations, and handling AST nodes using the goldmark library.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Extracts translatable segments from Markdown text, returning their positions and metadata.

methods.name: blockParent
methods.description: Finds the parent block node that is translatable, such as paragraph, heading, or list item.

methods.name: isTranslatableBlock
methods.description: Determines if an AST node is a translatable block (paragraph, heading, list item).

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Replaces segments in the original body with their translated text to produce the localized content.
